preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'val'))
preconditions.description: The input root is either None or a valid TreeNode with left, right, and val attributes.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right') and hasattr(root.left, 'val')) and (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right') and hasattr(root.right, 'val')))
preconditions.description: If root is not None, its children (if they exist) are also valid TreeNodes or None.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None if root is None else True
postconditions.description: If the input tree is empty, the function returns None; otherwise, it returns a valid head node.

postconditions.expression: return_value is not None and all((node.left is None and node.right is None) for node in get_original_leaves(root))
postconditions.description: All original leaf nodes of the tree are removed from the tree structure (their parent's left/right pointers are set to None).

postconditions.expression: return_value is not None and all((node.left is None and node.right is None) for node in get_original_leaves(root))
postconditions.description: The original leaf nodes are reconnected to form a doubly linked list where left acts as previous and right as next.

postconditions.expression: return_value is not None and get_dll_sequence(return_value) == get_inorder_leaf_sequence(root)
postconditions.description: The doubly linked list formed by the function contains the leaf nodes in the same order as their inorder traversal in the original tree.

postconditions.expression: return_value is not None and all(node.left is None or (hasattr(node.left, 'val') and node.left.right == node) for node in get_dll_nodes(return_value))
postconditions.description: In the resulting DLL, for every node, if it has a previous node (left), that previous node's next pointer (right) points back to the current node.

postconditions.expression: return_value is not None and all(node.right is None or (hasattr(node.right, 'val') and node.right.left == node) for node in get_dll_nodes(return_value))
postconditions.description: In the resulting DLL, for every node, if it has a next node (right), that next node's previous pointer (left) points back to the current node.
